name: Charon's Bell
description: (Tag:spirit)Ring the Ferryman's bell to call the souls of the dead to you, by default all souls in range, or a specific soul instantly if you hold something relevant like corpse parts or mementos, as long as their soul is in your dimension. Powerful unwilling targets can resist. Called spirits are not commanded but can be interacted with, and you can store 100 souls by default, equal to a grown person, increasing with energy reserves.
